blocks.text: A dynamic route folder uses a value from the address. Static export needs to know its allowed values at build time.

Use a Next.js App Router project. Save files at the paths shown. For these static examples, use output: "export" in next.config.ts and npm run build. They need Next.js tools and do not run in this playground.

blocks.title: Generate a small set of book pages

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `generateStaticParams` lists address values that a static Next.js build should turn into pages.

blocks.text: The build can create pages for moon-trip and garden-days. Their titles show the matching slug.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Static export cannot invent a new unknown route at request time. List the pages you want to build.

blocks.title: Your small task
blocks.text: Add one more slug to generateStaticParams.
